body:
Claim: implement the deduction engine (the top backlog row — fuse user/environment signals into ONE conclusion and act).

Scope and intent:
- New module `backend/src/core/user_context.py`: collect OS-level user/environment signals (locale, UI language, timezone, region/territory) via Python stdlib only (locale.getlocale, datetime/zoneinfo, os.environ LANG, Windows kernel32 GetLocaleInfoEx via ctypes when available), best-effort and never raising.
- Fuse the signals into ONE conclusion (country/region + timezone + language + confidence) with a deterministic converging-evidence algorithm — no LLM call, no hedged candidate lists; ties/insufficient evidence degrade to an honest "unknown" rather than a guess.
- Persist ONLY the stable part, keyed, with the established memory metadata tags (memory_freshness=boot, memory_confidence) via a small store next to SystemInfoStore — respecting the typed-write rules (volatile values like IP/ISP are never persisted).
- Boot wiring in `backend/src/api/app.py` lifespan next to the existing system-snapshot cache; prompt injection in `backend/src/core/agent/prompts.py` `_system_env_line()` region: a stable "User context" block plus a deduction-first contract line (when signals converge, commit to the conclusion and act; when they genuinely don't, say what's missing — never enumerate hedge candidates).
- Unit tests under `tests/core/` (collector determinism, fusion convergence, persistence gating, prompt injection shape).

Safety: additive; no existing tool/intent/adapter behavior changes; all new code best-effort so boot never blocks. Verification: ruff + targeted pytest on the changed areas, full pre-commit gate, then live-verify per the standing verification bar on the isolated 8765 harness before claiming "done".
